note: Re-judged 2026-10-12 (independent auditor) after 37dbe54095, where the authenticator with resumption on installs redeemTLS13Only (resumption.go), which refuses every TLS 1.2 ticket. This unit is byte-identical; the file around it changed. Its helpers (tls12Exchange, fullTLS12Flights) gained a tune argument passed as nil to driveTunedEAPTLSFlight, which driveEAPTLSFlight itself calls with nil, and fresh stores offer no ticket, so the producer change never runs here. Verdict stands. The weak HandshakeComplete tag on TestEAPTLSMutualAuthHandshakeSucceeds is gone. What remains reads the wire in both polarities, both recorded: the peer's ClientHello offers compression_methods [0] and the ServerHello selects 0 (TestRFC5216NeitherSideNegotiatesCompression); an injected ClientHello offering [1, 0] is answered with null compression (TestRFC5216ServerRefusesTheCompressionAPeerOffers).
